en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a European town square with a Gothic-style church featuring a rose window and tower at the center-right. The square is bordered by multi‑story townhouses with steep roofs and shop signs on the ground floors. A wide, mostly empty street runs diagonally, lined with small trimmed trees near the church. In the distance are more buildings and a large palace-like complex on a hill, with gentle hills or low mountains beyond. Visible shop signs on the closest corner buildings are in German, including business names and words like "Restauration".
